name: Soups & Such Cafe'
sourceUrl: https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/soups-and-such-cafe-julian?tab=menu — four in-store laminated-menu photos captioned by the uploader "Menu 1/2026" (January 2026, ~7 months before extraction on 2026-08-18). Read at full resolution from the Yelp CDN originals: https://s3-media0.fl.yelpcdn.com/bphoto/i_iefB_c5KQmebC3jrB7AA/o.jpg (soups, sandwiches, lunch specials), https://s3-media0.fl.yelpcdn.com/bphoto/zm-xtuTjRyvbKnAoXM_GLQ/o.jpg (burgers, salads, sides), https://s3-media0.fl.yelpcdn.com/bphoto/W0hh2XLhReV8FYtxzLKBBg/o.jpg (craft brews, wine), https://s3-media0.fl.yelpcdn.com/bphoto/JitInKWuITIf5Vh164nkpg/o.jpg (beverages, tea, desserts). Dated by the uploader's own caption text; corroborated as a genuinely newer menu revision because the vintage-dated wine list on the older zmenu photos (2015-2017 vintages) has been replaced here with "Ask server for today's selection". Dine-in laminated menu photographed in the restaurant; no delivery-app pricing involved.
